title: Tutor Feedback Theme Tracker
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speaking:session feedback_theme=*
| stats count as mentions by tutor feedback_theme
| sort - mentions
description: Aggregates the correction themes tutors keep repeating, such as pronunciation, word order, or tense choice.
value: Feedback is most useful when recurring themes are visible across sessions instead of forgotten after each lesson.
implementation: Normalize tutor feedback themes on `speaking:session` events and rank them by mention count.
visualization: Bar chart of tutor feedback themes.
grandmaExplanation: It maps the speaking mistakes teachers keep mentioning again and again.
